items.title: Apple AI tools come to China after two-year delay
items.summary: Apple began on Wednesday a long-delayed trial rollout of in-house artificial intelligence tools for Chinese users, playing catch-up to homegrown smartphone makers in a major market for the US giant.The long-anticipated Chinese rollout of Apple Intelligence "fills a long-standing gap in Apple's AI offering", said Ivan Lam, a senior analyst at Counterpoint Research.

items.title: Marvell Technology And 2 More High Growth Stocks To Watch
items.summary: Global central banks pausing rate hikes has pushed investors to look harder at where future earnings growth might come from. When cash and low risk assets feel less rewarding, businesses with the potential for strong profit expansion and solid balance sheets can draw more attention. This piece highlights three stocks from a US screener that focuses on financially robust companies with analyst forecasts for higher earnings over the next few years.
